name: Future Secure AI
desc: Builds supervised teams of AI agent co-workers for large organisations in banking, consulting, healthcare and law.
capacity_detail: Valued at US$1.2bn (A$1.7bn) in a US$80m (A$115m) convertible-note round, Nov 2026
markets: Founded in Sydney in 2023, now headquartered in Austin, Texas; serves large organisations in banking, consulting, healthcare and law

signals.raise: US$80m convertible notes from Square Peg, Yarra, Macquarie Asset Management and Firetrail at US$1.2bn valuation (Nov 2026; https://startupdaily.net/other/future-secure-ai-raises-us80-million-for-ai-co-workers)

rationale: Fast-growing enterprise AI brand selling to banks and consultancies; F1 hospitality and B2B tech partner peers suit enterprise sales before a planned listing.

name: Sagar Defence Engineering
desc: Indian maker of unmanned and autonomous defence systems, building an autonomous systems shipyard in Andhra Pradesh.
capacity_detail: Pre-IPO round of INR 300 crore at a pre-money valuation of INR 20,000 crore (about US$2.2bn), Nov 2026
markets: India: unmanned maritime and autonomous defence systems, with manufacturing and research in Pune and a shipyard in Andhra Pradesh

signals.raise: INR 300 crore pre-IPO round from domestic institutional investors at INR 20,000 crore pre-money (Nov 2026; https://www.indiasentinels.com/defence-industry/private/sagar-defence-engineering-raises-300-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-20000-crore-valuation-7695)
signals.ipo: Co-founder says SEBI's final observations received on draft offer document (Nov 2026; https://www.indiasentinels.com/defence-industry/private/sagar-defence-engineering-raises-300-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-20000-crore-valuation-7695)

rationale: Engineering-led defence brand heading to IPO; F1 technology association could build investor and talent profile, though defence branding is restricted.

name: PGP Glass
desc: Makes specialty glass packaging for cosmetics, perfumery, food, beverage and pharmaceutical brands in more than 70 countries.
ownership: private equity: Blackstone funds (sale to Brookfield agreed Nov 2026)
capacity_detail: Brookfield agreed to buy PGP Glass from Blackstone's funds for US$1.7bn, announced 23 Nov 2026
markets: Brands in more than 70 countries, served from three production facilities across India and Sri Lanka, with global logistics

signals.raise: Brookfield to acquire from Blackstone for US$1.7bn, closing expected Q1 2027 (Nov 2026; https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/brookfield-pgp-glass-blackstone-501869/)

rationale: Supplier to luxury perfume and drinks brands; F1 hospitality offers a B2B platform to entertain global brand-owner clients after the ownership change.

name: Simplexity Robotics
desc: Develops embodied AI and wheeled humanoid robots that prepare drinks, fetch objects and guide visitors.
capacity_detail: US$100m pre-Series A led by Ant Group valuing the company at US$1.6bn, Nov 2026
markets: China: embodied AI robots for physical tasks such as drink preparation, delivery, fetching and visitor guidance

signals.raise: US$100m pre-Series A led by Ant Group with Tencent, HSG and Lanchi at US$1.6bn valuation (Nov 2026; https://technode.com/2026/11/23/ant-group-leads-100-million-round-in-humanoid-startup-simplexity-robotics/)

rationale: Humanoid robotics is a showcase technology; F1 paddock visibility could build a global consumer-facing brand as Chinese robot makers seek attention.
